experimental_method: Static equilibrium cell (2400 cm3, Hastelloy), liquid sampled and analysed for total CO2 by ion chromatography; balance method also done but not reported.
uncertainties_stated: T +/-0.06 K; P +/-0.01 MPa; x1 4 % (ion chromatography); balance method 17 % (water), 5-16 % (NaOH)

not_extracted_tables.reason: literature compilation of T and p ranges (captured twice by the publisher HTML)

quality_remarks: Table 2 was served as three HTML fragments and Table 3 as two; they were stacked into one CSV each. Padding empty cells (298.15 K block has 6 rows vs 7 at 323.15 K) were dropped; no numbers changed.
Header carries plus-minus signs transliterated to +/-.
NaOH solution (Table 3) is outside the six-ion salt set but kept (NaOH listed under other_species); x1 at 0.3 MPa is already about 0.018 because CO2 reacts chemically with NaOH.
Abstract T range (293.15-393.15 K, up to 5 MPa) agrees with tables (pure water 298.15-393.15 K, NaOH 293.15-333.15 K, 0.28-5.14 MPa).
Replicate-like pairs at 373.15 K (5.03 MPa: 0.00874 and 0.00857) kept as printed.
Pressure printed with inconsistent digits (e.g. '0.6', '1', '3') kept verbatim.
mapping_audit: independent mapping audit 2026-10-02 (audit.json); cell-for-cell match with the captured HTML rows
